plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: Targeting ~1.5% monthly return with a focus on low drawdowns. Significant cash buffer and reduced leverage provide downside protection. Risk remains from broad market downturns.

plan: Reduce broad index (SPY) to 25% to free up capital.
